description: This file defines the OAuthAccessToken entity class for the OrangeHRM system, representing OAuth 2.0 access tokens with properties like token string, client ID, user ID, expiry, and revoked status, including getter and setter methods.

classes.name: OAuthAccessToken
classes.description: Entity class representing OAuth 2.0 access tokens with properties for token details, expiry, and revocation status.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the access token.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the access token.

methods.name: getClientId
methods.description: Returns the client ID associated with the token.

methods.name: setClientId
methods.description: Sets the client ID associated with the token.

methods.name: getUserId
methods.description: Returns the user ID associated with the token.

methods.name: setUserId
methods.description: Sets the user ID associated with the token.

methods.name: getExpiryDateTime
methods.description: Returns the expiry date and time of the token in UTC.

methods.name: setExpiryDateTime
methods.description: Sets the expiry date and time of the token.

methods.name: isRevoked
methods.description: Checks if the token has been revoked.

methods.name: setRevoked
methods.description: Sets the revoked status of the token.
